g.text: Scientific guide — evidence and limits
Reading an aNEOS result
This development build supports reproducible research screening. It is not an operational warning service, an independently calibrated discovery procedure
or an origin classifier. A successful query is not proof of complete observations.
Start with the evidence
Check the designation and catalogue identity, source and retrieval time, observation arc, orbit solution and epoch. Distinguish observations from fitted
parameters and computed encounters. Preserve native units, time scales, uncertainty and covariance labels. A catalogue query date or predicted encounter is
not an observation date.
Missing values mean not available, never zero. Conflicting identities or measurements need resolution or an explicit alternative; more rows are not
necessarily more independent evidence. Completeness is meaningful only against a declared required field set. Source coverage, enrichment completion and
analysis readiness are different. The target is all obtainable required data, with unresolved gaps shown honestly.
What the screening result means
Output
Meaning
What it does not establish
Screening score
Uncalibrated ranking under the stated engine/reference
Gaussian significance or origin probability
FOLLOW_UP_CANDIDATE
Ranking meets the recorded policy threshold
An artificial object or a validated physical anomaly
NOT_FLAGGED
This policy did not flag the supplied evidence
Perfectly normal, natural origin or no need for other
research
INCONCLUSIVE
Evidence or model prerequisites do not support the operation
A negative scientific finding
Null significance/probability
No justified calibrated result is available
Zero risk, zero anomaly or zero probability
The existing rank includes dependent proxies and prototype population assumptions. Size, albedo and absolute magnitude must not be treated as independent
origin evidence. The report records evidence, reference/policy identifiers and limitations; compare like-for-like inputs and versions rather than
interpreting a rank as a probability.
Physical dynamics and comparative explanations
A1, A2 and A3 are radial, transverse and out-of-plane force-model coefficients. Check their source units, uncertainties, estimated/fixed/considered status
and orbit solution. A coefficient or improved fit does not identify a cause. Assess compatible natural, human-technology and measurement/model-artifact
explanations against the same observations, with uncertainty, parameter complexity and predictive checks. A human spacecraft hypothesis is not
extraterrestrial evidence.
No valid physical-origin fit comparison or calibrated origin probability is installed in the current normal screening path. Keep unsupported conclusions
unresolved. A five-sigma claim needs a validated null and the full search/error-control procedure; no fixed ranking threshold supplies that evidence.
Population and impact views
Population neighbourhoods and native-TDB computed encounter gaps are descriptive. They do not establish a common origin, deliberate coordination, measured
acceleration periodicity or calibrated network significance. Cross-object temporal correlation requires compatible paired observations, not one fitted
scalar per object.
JPL Sentry evidence concerns the source model's tabulated Earth events and scope. Not listed is not zero impact probability. Impact evidence and origin
screening are separate; a screening rank cannot supply a collision probability or risk class.
Reproduce, then investigate
Save the JSON/Markdown report, exact inputs/configuration, evidence/policy/report IDs, source solution/epoch and software identity. Compare archived
assessments rather than overwrite them with later measurements. A completed execution means work was stored, not that every scientific prerequisite passed.
Check missing evidence and follow-up needs before deriving a physical conclusion.
Detailed current contracts: docs/scientific/VALIDATION_INTEGRITY.md and the scoped reports in docs/engineering/. The older scientific-documentation.md is
historical prototype material, not current validated methodology. Full object explanations, menu QA, source enrichment and independent evaluation remain
active work (#40–#46).
